correctness.rationale: Let A=Cl(H_n-e), K=Cl(H_n). The common-neighbor edge link L has two (n-3)-simplices joined by n-2 disjoint cross-edges, hence L≃ wedge^(n-3) S1; independently enumerated this link for every n=4..10. The pair (K,A) has H3(K,A)=Z^(n-3) and zero other reduced relative homology. Four-coordinate even-parity cross-polytope S3 cycles containing e induce a unimodular basis of this relative H3, so H3(K)->H3(K,A) is surjective integrally and H3(A) injects primitively with rank B_n-(n-3). The full K is simply connected by parity-Cayley generators and filled squares, and Van Kampen for K=A∪(e*L) with simply connected ΣL gives A simply connected. By Hurewicz and homological Whitehead, A is wedge of the stated number of S3. Exact B_n and link ranks for n4..10 independently computed; these do not substitute for the all-n proof.
